text_block_list.text:
Vivlos congratulated her other older 
sister, Cheval Grand, on her race victory, 
but Cheval told her it was better not to 
bother with her.

To avoid comparison with her sister, she 
chose the Classic Triple Crown, yet could 
not enter the Classic races— Cheval Grand 
belittled herself with such thoughts.

Even so, Vivlos admired her for choosing 
to run her own path rather than the one 
Verxina paved, calling her "so cool" with 
deep trust.

Even if her feelings don't reach them now, 
someday they will— Just as her Trainer 
thinks this, the sound of Vivlos coughing 
reaches their ears.
